title: Platelet volume–count coupling does not establish incremental CRP prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A frozen platelet volume–count interaction developed in 4,079 NHANES2005–06 adults was tested in 4,889 independent-sample2007–08 adults beyond flexible marginal MPV,platelet count,WBC,NLR,RDW and confounders. Weighted log-CRP MSE improved by 0.0002795 (0.025%),but target and source-refit design-bootstrap95%intervals included zero and development grouped crossvalidation worsened. Stable incremental utility is not established. This is a negative representation test,not evidence against platelet biology.
